# Atlas Glinn, LLC

> Executive protection, risk management, and security technology firm based in
> Houston, Texas. Atlas Glinn provides licensed protective services to
> executives, families, and high-net-worth principals, and builds the field
> technology its own operators use.

Atlas Glinn operates two connected lines of business: protective services
delivered by licensed agents, and the security technology that supports them —
including Atlas EP, an iOS application for protection details, and counter-drone
and autonomous surveillance systems.

## Services

- [Executive & Dignitary Protection](https://atlasglinn.com/executive-protection.html): Licensed close protection for executives, dignitaries, and families. Armed and unarmed details, secure transport, advance work, and route planning.
- [Residential Protection](https://atlasglinn.com/residential-protection.html): Estate and residential security programs, including standing posts and technical surveillance countermeasures.
- [Counter-Drone / C-UAS](https://atlasglinn.com/cuas-aerodefense.html): Detection and mitigation of unauthorized unmanned aircraft over sensitive sites and events.
- [Autonomous Drone Security](https://atlasglinn.com/uas.html): UAS-based perimeter and site surveillance.
- [Disaster Recovery & Asset Protection](https://atlasglinn.com/disaster-recovery.html): Continuity and asset security during natural disasters and civil disruption.
- [Training](https://atlasglinn.com/training.html): Protective operations instruction delivered with MAST Solutions.

## Technology

- [Atlas EP App](https://atlasglinn.com/ep-app.html): iOS application for protection details — daily activity reports, team coordination, emergency signalling, and situational intelligence.
- [Technology Overview](https://atlasglinn.com/technology.html): The systems Atlas Glinn fields and develops.
